quotes.handoff-bytes: Photonic interconnect is *not* Fourier optics: `cpo-optical` is an illustrative co-packaged-optics link (round numbers; optical I/O chiplets reach multi-Tb/s, Wade et al., IEEE Micro 2020). Hand-off for a 2,048-token prompt: GQA KV cache 268.4 MB; Hyena direct cache 1,073.7 MB; Hyena distilled state 16.8 MB. All-H100 pools.
quotes.eth25-saturation: **Load sweep: GQA KV over 25 GbE** (the link saturates near 11.6 req/s uncompressed: 268.4 MB per 2,048-token prompt at 3.125 GB/s). Same workload otherwise.
